title: Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meeting decision (MPM Sep 17-18)
source: NEWS: boj.or.jp 'Monetary Policy Meetings' schedule page (en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/), read direct 2026-09-05 — lists the September 2026 MPM as 17-18 September, decision published at the meeting's conclusion on the second day; the second date on the same row is the Summary of Opinions, not the decision. CORRECTED 2026-09-05 (initial research): the policy rate is 1.0%, NOT the 0.75% this line previously carried — the BoJ's 31 July 2026 Statement on Monetary Policy (PDF fetched and text-extracted direct) reads 'The Bank will encourage the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.0 percent', decided 'by an 8-1 majority vote', with TAKATA Hajime dissenting in favour of 1.25%. 0.75% was the December 2025 level, superseded by a June 2026 hike to 1.0% (highest since 1995). The Summary of Opinions date is likewise unresolved: the schedule row reads Oct. 1 while this note previously said 09-28, and the table's offset structure makes both readable — left for the next pulse rather than guessed. THE DATE IS PRIMARY-VERIFIED AND THE STATUS STILL READS ESTIMATE for the same reason as ecb-decision-2026-09-10: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for any other central bank. Understating the label only widens caution.
notes: Proposed during the fomc-2026-09-16 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). Lands two days after the Sep-16 FOMC, the day the US communications blackout lifts, and on quarterly triple-witching (opex-2026-09-18) — three duration-relevant things on one session. THE CHANNEL IS THE CARRY TRADE, NOT JAPAN: a BoJ move at a 0.75% policy rate propagates to this calendar's long-duration AI names through yen funding and global term premium, which is the same transmission the FOMC ledger tracks through the 10Y. It is also the first read on how a foreign central bank marks the US decision it just watched. IMPACT IS MEDIUM, deliberately: the mechanism is real but second-order for a US equity book, and the decision announcement lands overnight ET, so any effect reaches the tape as a 09-18 open — the one session of the quarter where opex pinning is the dominant microstructure. Overnight-ET timing means the statement is technically 09-18 JST; the date here is the JST decision date, matching how the BoJ itself publishes it.
